name: instance-search
description: Advanced instance search for Chronicle: a JSON query tree (and/or/not, any_player, count_players, any_encounter, count_encounters, field predicates) compiled to one parameterized, tenant-safe SQL query by internal/instancesearch. Use when: writing or explaining a search query, translating a natural-language question ("raids with 3+ priests and a 95 clear parse") into a query, adding a searchable field, or touching the compiler.
